description: Audit Huawei Cloud OBS bucket security configuration: ACL permissions, Block Public Access (BPA), encryption (SSE-KMS/SSE-OBS/SSE-C), versioning, cross-region replication, HTTPS enforcement (SecureTransport), bucket logging, Referer anti-hotlinking, CORS rules, and object naming patterns. Generates a security score report with risk items and remediation recommendations. Use when the user wants to: perform a security audit on an OBS bucket, check bucket ACL permissions, verify BPA status, review encryption configuration, check versioning and replication, audit HTTPS enforcement, review logging and anti-hotlinking, inspect CORS rules, detect sequential object naming patterns, or generate a comprehensive OBS security assessment report. Triggers include: "OBS安全审计", "OBS安全配置", "桶安全检查", "安全评分", "ACL权限审计", "BPA状态", "桶加密检查", "多版本控制", "跨区域复制", "HTTPS强制传输", "桶日志", "防盗链", "CORS规则", "对象命名", "OBS security audit", "bucket security", "security score", "BPA status", "encryption check", "versioning check", "replication check", "HTTPS enforcement", "bucket logging", "anti-hotlinking", "Referer check", "CORS check", "naming pattern".
